info.name: SecurewaveNG
info.description:
🚀 SecureWaveNG API Documentation

Overview

SecureWaveNG is a modern payment gateway that enables businesses to collect payments, generate virtual bank accounts, issue USD virtual cards, and receive real-time transaction notifications through secure webhooks.

Base URL

https://securewaveng.com/api

✨ Features

  • Reliable

  • Secure

  • Easy to integrate

  • Built for Nigerian payment flows

  • Developer-friendly

  • Production-ready

All API requests and responses are in JSON format and must be sent over HTTPS.

🏦 Virtual Accounts

Overview

SecureWaveNG Virtual Accounts allow merchants to generate dedicated bank account numbers for customers to receive payments seamlessly.

These accounts automate collections and eliminate manual bank confirmation, enabling instant reconciliation.

Use Cases

  • Wallet funding

  • Customer deposits

  • Subscription payments

  • Invoice payments

  • Automated collections

Types of Virtual Accounts

🔹 Static Virtual Accounts

A permanent account number assigned to a specific customer.

Best for:

  • Repeat deposits

  • Long-term wallet funding

  • Ongoing customer accounts

Key Features:

  • Does not expire

  • Linked to one customer

  • Reusable for multiple transactions

🔹 Dynamic Virtual Accounts

A temporary account number generated for a specific transaction.

Best for:

  • One-time payments

  • Invoice settlement

  • Checkout payments

Key Features:

  • Expires after payment or set duration

  • Linked to a specific amount

  • Single-use

🔄 Payment Flow

  1. Merchant generates a virtual account via API

  2. SecureWaveNG assigns a bank account number

  3. Customer transfers funds

  4. Payment is automatically confirmed

  5. Webhook notification is sent

  6. Merchant updates system

💳 Virtual Cards

Overview

SecureWaveNG Virtual Cards enable merchants to issue USD virtual cards for customers.

Use Cases

  • Online purchases

  • SaaS subscriptions

  • Hosting services

  • Ads payments

  • International transactions

Capabilities

  • Activate customers (KYC)

  • Create cards

  • Fund cards

  • Freeze / Unfreeze

  • Refresh balance

  • Retrieve card details

  • List all cards

Lifecycle

  1. Activate customer

  2. Create card

  3. Fund card

  4. Monitor usage

  5. Freeze/unfreeze

🧾 BVN VERIFICATION

Overview

SecureWaveNG BVN Verification API allows merchants to verify customer identity using Nigeria’s Bank Verification Number (BVN) system.

Use Cases

  • KYC verification

  • Fraud prevention

  • Identity validation

  • Regulatory compliance

📬 Webhooks

Overview

SecureWaveNG sends real-time notifications via webhooks.

Each payload is secured using:

HMAC-SHA256

Headers

Header Description
X-Signature HMAC-SHA256 signature of payload

🏦 Virtual Account Webhook

Example Payload

{
  "notification_status": "payment_successful",
  "transaction_id": "TX123456789",
  "provider_reference": "PROV12345",
  "amount": 10000,
  "fees": 100,
  "settlement_amount": 9900,
  "currency": "NGN",
  "transaction_type": "transfer",
  "transaction_status": "success",
  "sender": {
    "name": "John Doe",
    "account_number": "1234567890",
    "bank": "GTBank"
  },
  "receiver": {
    "name": "Jane Smith",
    "account_number": "0987654321",
    "bank": "Access Bank"
  },
  "customer": {
    "customer_id": 123,
    "name": "John Doe",
    "email": "john@example.com",
    "phone": "+2348012345678"
  },
  "description": "Payment received",
  "provider": {
    "name": "securewaveng",
    "channel": "virtual_account"
  }
}

💳 Virtual Card Webhook

Example Payload

{
  "card": {
    "type": "virtual",
    "brand": "MASTERCARD",
    "balance": "2.00",
    "card_id": "bec4db6c-54e1-4de9-b3f1-a471df81c82b",
    "first_six": "517746",
    "last_four": "0154",
    "previous_balance": "2.00"
  },
  "meta": {
    "reason": null,
    "provider_event": "cards.auth.verified"
  },
  "amount": 0,
  "currency": "USD",
  "customer": {
    "customer_id": "47a801f6-57c9-4330-9e88-4e14b8efe202"
  },
  "merchant": {
    "name": "NAME-CHEAP.COM PHOENIX AZUS",
    "country": null
  },
  "provider": "securewaveng",
  "created_at": "2026-03-23 19:00:12",
  "event_type": "card.transaction",
  "event_action": "mcc_decline",
  "transaction_status": "failed"
}

🔐 Signature Verification

Formula

HMAC_SHA256(secret, raw_payload)

Security Rules

  • Reject invalid signatures

  • Always verify payload

  • Optional: prevent replay attacks

PHP (Laravel)

public function securewaveWebhook(Request $request)
{
    $raw = $request->getContent();
    $signature = $request->header('X-Signature');
    $secret = config('services.securewave.webhook_secret');
    if (!$signature) {
        return response()->json(['error' => 'Missing signature'], 400);
    }
    $expected = hash_hmac('sha256', $raw, $secret);
    if (!hash_equals($expected, $signature)) {
        return response()->json(['error' => 'Invalid signature'], 401);
    }
    $payload = json_decode($raw, true);
    return response()->json(['status' => 'ok']);
}

Node.js

const crypto = require('crypto');
const expected = crypto
  .createHmac('sha256', WEBHOOK_SECRET)
  .update(raw)
  .digest('hex');

Python

expected = hmac.new(
    WEBHOOK_SECRET.encode(),
    raw,
    hashlib.sha256
).hexdigest()

🏦 Virtual Accounts

SecureWaveNG Virtual Accounts allow you to generate dedicated bank account numbers for your customers to receive payments instantly. Each payment made to a virtual account is automatically tracked, verified, and reported in real time via webhooks.

Virtual accounts eliminate manual reconciliation and make it easy to accept transfers, track payments, and scale collections securely.
